CJ guarantees the output-voltage band only for -14.5V <= Vi <= -27V and publishes dropout only as a 1.1V typical at Io=1A/25 degC with no maximum; the -13.5V project rail leaves 1.5V headroom, 1.0V short of the guaranteed band start, so regulation at the project operating point must be closed on the bench, not from this datasheet.
